signals.title: Ahmedabied/agent-guard
signals.content: Guardrails as code for AI agents: a policy proxy and HTTP gateway in front of MCP tool servers (stdio and Streamable HTTP), with a hash-chained audit log.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 72. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: Ahmedabied/agent-guard

Guardrails as code for AI agents: a policy proxy and HTTP gateway placed before MCP tool servers (both stdio and streamable HTTP). The proxy enforces configurable policy rules and forwards allowed requests, while simultaneously recording every interaction in a hash‑chained audit log to ensure tamper‑evidence and traceability.

العنوان: أحمدابيد/حارس‑الوكيل

حواجز الحماية ككود للوكالات الذكائية: بروكسي سياسات وبوابة HTTP توضع أمام خوادم أدوات MCP (سواء عبر stdio أو HTTP المتدفقة). يفرض البروكسي قواعد سياسات قابلة للتكوين ويُمرّر الطلبات المسموح بها فقط، بينما يسجل جميع التفاعلات في سجل تدقيق متسلسل بالهاش لضمان عدم التلاعب وإمكانية التتبع.

signals.title: craigmbrown/blindoracle-sdk
signals.content: BlindOracle SDK — verifiable AI-agent identity, audit, and delegation (Python).
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en: The open-source repository 'craigmbrown/blindoracle-sdk' provides a Python SDK focused on verifiable identity, cryptographically verifiable execution, auditing, and delegation for autonomous AI agents. The framework addresses strategic risks in agentic workflows by establishing traceable provenance, operational audit trails, and strict policy-based access delegation to mitigate unauthorized autonomous actions.

signals.title: d96moe/ha-nutrition
signals.content: Home Assistant integration: a food log that AI agents (claude.ai over MCP) and automations write to, with today sensors, goals and daily statistics
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: d96moe/ha-nutrition
Integration: Home Assistant module that records a food log. AI agents (Claude via MCP) and automation scripts write entries, capture sensor data for the current day, compare against nutritional goals, and generate daily statistics. The system provides OSINT‑style visibility into consumption patterns, supports strategic health monitoring, and flags deviations while preserving uncertainty about exact intake when data is incomplete.

العنوان: d96moe/ha-nutrition
التكامل: وحدة Home Assistant تسجل سجلًا غذائيًا. يكتب وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي (Claude عبر MCP) والبرمجيات الآلية الإدخالات، وتجمع بيانات المستشعرات لليوم الحالي، وتقارنها بالأهداف الغذائية، وتنتج إحصاءات يومية. يوفر النظام رؤية على نمط الاستهلاك بأسلوب OSINT، يدعم المراقبة الاستراتيجية للصحة، ويشير إلى الانحرافات مع الحفاظ على عدم اليقين عندما تكون البيانات غير مكتملة.

signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: a2a-settlement/settlebridge-ai

SettleBridge Gateway provides a trusted, policy‑enforced layer for agent‑to‑agent settlement. It authenticates counterparties, validates transaction parameters against configurable rules, and logs all actions for audit. The system supports multiple protocols and can be integrated into existing AI orchestration stacks, enabling secure, compliant value exchange between autonomous agents while preserving operational transparency.

signals.title: @DIU_x: DIU has awarded three prototype contracts in support of the Autonomous Low Profile Vessel (ALPV) project, a critical effort supporting resup
signals.content: DIU has awarded three prototype contracts in support of the Autonomous Low Profile Vessel (ALPV) project, a critical effort supporting resupply efforts of @USMC units spread across wide distances in contested littoral environments. The ultimate goal: Rapid prototyping and fielding at scale. The Marine Corps has previously prototyped several ALPV variants, but we must move faster while reducing costs. The DIU ALPV project opens the aperture to best-in-class commercial autonomy solutions and vessel designs, while delivering superior capability to Marine operators. We look forward to working with our commercial partners at Rudder Industries (a first-time DoW partner), @Saronic, and @SeaMachines Robotics, who were selected following a competitive solicitation earlier this year. We will also be side-by-side throughout development with our DoW counterparts at @PAEMaritime, to include the Capabilities Development and Force Integration Directorate (CDFi) and the Marine Corps @WarfightingLab (MCWL), @DRPM_RAS and Naval Sea Systems Command (@NAVSEA) Combatant Craft Division (CCD).
